req.title: Update task
req.statement: The system shall update mutable fields of the task and return the updated object when PUT /tasks/{task_id} is called with a valid body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers PUT /tasks/{task_id} updating mutable fields and returning the updated object. I designed tests covering: (1) EP positive – update all mutable fields on a known task and assert exact response values; (2) NEG – update a non-existent task_id returns exactly 404; (3) BVA – title at max length boundary (100 chars) succeeds, title at 101 chars fails with 422; (4) STC – toggle completed from false to true then back to false to verify state transitions; (5) DT – partial update (only one field) leaves other fields unchanged. Each test uses pre-loaded rows (ids 1-20), asserts exact status codes and field values to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_values
preconditions: Task id=7 exists with title='Fix login bug', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with body {title: 'Fixed login bug', description: 'All done', completed: true}
expected: Response body has id=7, title='Fixed login bug', description='All done', completed=true
trace: R-TASK-010: update mutable fields; return updated object
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_update_task_all_fields_returns_200_with_updated_values():
    payload = {"title": "Fixed login bug", "description": "All done", "completed": True}
    r = client.put("/tasks/7", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 7
    assert body["title"] == "Fixed login bug"
    assert body["description"] == "All done"
    assert body["completed"] is True
    assert "created_at" in body

tests.name: test_update_task_title_at_max_length_boundary_succeeds
preconditions: Task id=10 exists with title='Organize desk'
actions: PUT /tasks/10 with title of exactly 100 characters (max allowed)
PUT /tasks/10 with title of exactly 101 characters (one over max)
expected: 100-char title: HTTP 200, title in response equals the 100-char string
trace: R-TASK-010: boundary on title max_length=100; BVA at n and n+1
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_update_task_title_at_max_length_boundary_succeeds():
    title_100 = "A" * 100
    r = client.put("/tasks/10", json={"title": title_100})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == title_100
    assert len(body["title"]) == 100

    title_101 = "A" * 101
    r2 = client.put("/tasks/10", json={"title": title_101})
    assert r2.status_code == 422

trace: R-TASK-010: state transition on completed field; STC false->true->false
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_update_task_completed_state_transition_false_to_true_to_false():
    r1 = client.put("/tasks/4", json={"completed": True})
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    b1 = r1.json()
    assert b1["id"] == 4
    assert b1["completed"] is True

    r2 = client.put("/tasks/4", json={"completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    b2 = r2.json()
    assert b2["id"] == 4
    assert b2["completed"] is False
